meta.title: CtxKit context library
meta.description: Organizes new work in opted-in workspaces into Markdown session checkpoints, topic knowledge and inert procedure drafts, with provenance and on-demand recall. Inactive by default: configure an existing vault, allowed workspaces and a summarization model before enabling. Read-only sessions do not write. No automatic deployment, skill installation or full-history scan. This 0.1 MVP exposes processing failures through ctxkit_status.
